# Note

Workshop plan for 2026 is a bit different and we are running a hodgepodge of topics.  Part of the rationale is the changing landscape brought by AI.  


# Workshop Structure

This is a 4-day workshop (SEP 08-11 2025) with each day running from 9am-12pm. During each day’s session, we will cover a new topic in the workflow pipeline.

- 2026/Oct/06 (Tuesday) - Module 1: AI in data science (Ben/Paul)

- 2026/Oct/13 (Tuesday) - Module 2: QGIS (Adrian)

- 2026/Oct/20 (Tuesday) - Module 3: Vibe-coding (Ben/Paul)

- 2026/Oct/22 (Thursday) - Module 4: eDNA (Lauren)


*\* Notes \*\*

We will not be offended if you only attend part of a session.
